Beyond producing and validating the baseline independent Gaussian chains, the agent clearly improves the methodology by enforcing physical priors (f_EDE ≥ 0, τ > 0), constructing correlated Gaussian chains incorporating CMB+BAO degeneracies (with CAMB θ_* gradient calibration for ΛCDM), and propagating samples through CAMB to generate consistent triangle plots and 68% distance bands. While mock Gaussian chains still rely on assumed correlation matrices for EDE and w₀wₐ rather than full likelihood posteriors from the published paper, the exact marginal calibration, dual independent/correlated comparison, and CAMB physical validation exceed the baseline reproduction standard.

items.reasoning: Evaluated under Mode A (Objective), the AI-generated 7-parameter triangle plots (both the correlated chain and the independent baseline) accurately reproduce all target marginal distributions and parameter shifts to within 0.8% of the tabulated 1σ widths, correctly placing EDE at H₀≈70.9 km/s/Mpc, σ₈≈0.828, nₛ≈0.982, and Ωₘ≈0.300, ΛCDM at H₀≈68.1 and σ₈≈0.810, and w₀wₐCDM in the opposite direction at H₀≈63.5 and Ωₘ≈0.353. The report clearly connects these opposing shifts to early-time sound-horizon reduction versus late-time distance modification, while improving upon the target benchmark plot by fixing 1D/2D color consistency and adding both physically motivated parameter degeneracies and a dedicated EDE (f_EDE, log₁₀a_c) triangle plot. A score slightly above 50 reflects these improvements over the uncorrelated target plot, tempered by the reliance on heuristic correlation matrices (and a somewhat over-constrained θ_*-calibrated Ωₘ–H₀ contour for ΛCDM) rather than full MCMC likelihood sampling.
